curation.lead:
Joshua Harris (born 1965) is an American billionaire, co-founder of Apollo Global Management, and owner of the Philadelphia 76ers, New Jersey Devils, and Washington Commanders. Of the three Apollo co-founders, Harris has maintained the lowest public profile regarding his relationship with Jeffrey Epstein. The January 2021 Dechert LLP investigation, commissioned by Apollo's own Conflicts Committee, concluded that the Epstein relationship was primarily with Leon Black and that "neither co-founder hired Epstein." The documentary record from DOJ Volume 11 tells a different story. Harris had at minimum eight confirmed in-person meetings with Epstein between October 2013 and February 2014, exchanged casual direct emails from his Apollo account, provided Epstein with "organizational docs" at Epstein's request, and was explicitly named in Epstein's January 2016 fee proposal for Athene restructuring advisory work: "marc and josh would have to sign on" (EFTA02655647).

The Harris-Epstein relationship spans nearly a decade of documented contact. Michael Wolff's unpublished Epstein profile, found in multiple drafts among House Oversight documents, placed Harris at dinners at Epstein's 9 East 71st Street residence after the 2008 conviction, alongside Ron Baron and Nobel laureate Richard Axel. By late 2013, Harris was attending early-morning meetings at the Epstein residence -- including an October 22, 2013 session at 7:30am with all three Apollo founders present (EFTA02576529). A November 2014 email exchange captures the personal tone: Harris wrote "Hey Jeff. Sorry i missed you. Crazy week?" and asked "Whats this Bill Gates thing about? Tks for thinking about me." Epstein was brokering an introduction to Bill Gates for a December 5, 2014 dinner. The relationship was warm, direct, and centered on access to Epstein's network of powerful individuals.

By 2016, the relationship had evolved from social networking to sensitive tax and corporate matters. Epstein's "leon agenda" memo of August 15, 2016 included the item "sit with josh and mark re amendments" alongside Athene-related business (EFTA02455405). In September 2016, Harris began routing communications with Epstein through Bob Bodian, a partner at Mintz Levin -- a shift from casual emails to attorney-mediated contact that suggests increasing legal sensitivity. By December 2016, three major law firms (Mintz Levin, Paul Weiss, Akin Gump) were coordinating on "the Josh tax letter" regarding IRS Form 8865 reasonable cause filings for the Apollo founders' BRH Holdings structure. Brad Karp, chairman of Paul Weiss, personally forwarded this email chain to Epstein with "Fyi, Jeffrey" -- confirming that Epstein was kept informed of Harris's most sensitive tax compliance matters by one of the most powerful lawyers in the country. The question of whether Rowan and Harris ever signed on to Epstein's proposed 25% advisory fee -- potentially worth million per founder -- remains unanswered in the documentary record.
open_questions: Did Harris ever sign on to Epstein's proposed 25% Athene advisory fee ( million per founder)? No document in the record confirms or denies payment from Harris to Epstein -- only the proposal exists.

What were the 'organizational docs' Epstein requested from Harris in early 2014 (EFTA02581638)? Given the timing coinciding with Apollo's IPO transition, these likely concerned partnership agreements or corporate structure documents, but their specific nature and what Epstein did with them remain unknown.

What was discussed in the Bodian-Epstein calls of September 17-18, 2016? The shift from direct casual emails to attorney-mediated contact suggests the subject matter had become legally sensitive, but the substance is not captured in the documentary record.

Was the IRS Form 8865 reasonable cause filing for Harris's BRH Holdings interests accepted by the IRS, and were penalties assessed? The three-firm coordination and the 'statement that Taxpayers are not under civil or criminal investigation' language suggest the stakes were high, but the outcome is not documented.

What was the scope and outcome of the Dechert investigation's inquiry into Harris's and Rowan's relationships with Epstein? The published summary focused on Black, but the underlying work papers -- if they addressed the three-founder fee proposal and shared Form 8865 work at all -- have not been made public.
curation.system_role: Harris represents the quietest member of the Apollo triad's engagement with Epstein: the co-founder whose documented meetings, casual emails, organizational document sharing, and inclusion in fee negotiations contradict the Dechert report's framing of a Black-only relationship, while his late-stage shift to attorney-mediated communications and involvement in a multi-firm IRS compliance effort coordinated by Epstein reveal a principal whose exposure extended well beyond social dinners into Apollo's most sensitive corporate and tax matters.

sections.title: Documented Meetings and the Personal Relationship
sections.content:
The documentary record establishes at least eight confirmed in-person meetings between Harris and Epstein in a four-month period from October 2013 to February 2014. The first -- and structurally most significant -- was the October 22, 2013 meeting at 7:30am at Epstein's residence that included all three Apollo co-founders: Harris, Leon Black, and Marc Rowan (EFTA02576529). This was not a social call; the scheduling emails show that "Leon is asking if you could do earlier... 7 or 7:30am... Josh will do it then and Melanie is checking with Marc." The coordination required to get three billionaires to a single 7:30am appointment suggests high-priority business, not a casual breakfast.

Harris returned for a solo breakfast with Epstein on November 7, 2013 (EFTA02576791). When both Harris and Rowan were traveling that same week, Lesley Groff attempted to organize a conference call between the three of them (EFTA02576924) -- further evidence of their collective engagement. Harris visited again on December 4, 2013, returned Epstein's call on December 9, visited on January 9, 2014 from 11:15am to 12:15pm (the same day as Michael Wolff at 9am, Boris Nikolic at 5pm, and Benny Shabtai at 7pm), and had a "TBD" appointment scheduled alongside Black's February 13, 2014 lunch. On February 6, 2014, Groff asked Epstein about following up on "organizational docs" Harris had been asked to provide (EFTA02581638), indicating that information was flowing in both directions: Epstein was requesting and receiving internal Apollo documents from Harris.

The personal dimension is captured in a November 26, 2014 email exchange. Harris, writing from his Apollo account, messaged Epstein: "Hey Jeff. Sorry i missed you. Crazy week? U around any time from now to sunday? Whats this Bill Gates thing about? Tks for thinking about me." Epstein replied: "call me tomorw if you get a chance-I thought you might like to schmooze, get some of his ideas etc. nothing but fun friday 5th breakfast." Harris responded: "Cool. Will do. Thx." A separate scheduling document (EFTA02595966) confirms Epstein was organizing a December 5 dinner with Bill Gates that included both Harris and Ron Baron. The exchange reveals two things: a casual personal friendship conducted through Harris's official Apollo email (not a private account), and Epstein's role as a broker of introductions to individuals like Gates -- the currency that made Epstein valuable to people who did not need his money.

sections.title: The Athene Fee and the Apollo Triad
sections.content:
The most consequential evidence against the "Black-only" narrative comes from Epstein's own fee proposal. On January 18, 2016, Epstein emailed Melanie Spinella, Leon Black's executive assistant at Apollo: "I propose a 25% fee based on benefit to all founders... if there is a 300 overall benefit, then each founder would pay 25 m... If OK with you, marc and josh would have to sign on" (EFTA02655647). The email was addressed to Spinella but the fee structure explicitly required Harris's agreement. The proposed total -- up to million, split equally among three founders at million each -- was predicated on Epstein's advisory work on the Athene restructuring, a transaction Epstein elsewhere described as involving "2 billion in taxes on transaction." Epstein forwarded this email to himself on March 25, 2017, likely preserving the record for leverage or negotiation purposes.

Seven months later, Epstein's "leon agenda" memo of August 15, 2016 (EFTA02455405) listed fourteen action items for his meeting with Black, including "10 apollo insurance AThene" and "14. sit with josh and mark re amendments." The juxtaposition is significant: Epstein was managing the Athene restructuring as a single workstream that required coordination among all three founders. The "amendments" likely refer to modifications to the Apollo partnership agreement or the BRH Holdings LP structure through which the founders held their Apollo and Athene interests. These were not social-calendar items; they were corporate governance actions requiring the consent of all principals.

Separately, Epstein told Rowan directly: "I am waiting on you to decide whether you want me to move forward, and if, and only if successful, what you three propose as a fee" (EFTA02471986). The use of "you three" confirms Epstein understood his client as the founding partnership, not Leon Black individually. A Black Family Partners cash flow projection from December 2014 (EFTA02371750) shows the Athene capital call at .6 million as the single largest disbursement -- context that explains why Epstein structured the fee to spread across all three founders rather than loading it onto Black alone. The documentary record thus establishes that Harris was not a bystander to the Epstein advisory relationship but a named party in its most significant financial proposal.

sections.title: The Bodian Intermediary and Legal Sophistication
sections.content:
In September 2016, the character of Harris's communications with Epstein shifted. Rather than emailing directly from his Apollo account as he had in 2014, Harris began routing contact through Bob Bodian, a partner at Mintz Levin Cohn Ferris Glovsky and Popeo, P.C. On September 15, 2016, Bodian emailed Epstein: "Reaching out per Josh request. Reachable tomorrow on cell after 1:30" (EFTA02450532). Epstein replied on September 17: "does now work?" Scheduling documents confirm Bodian-Epstein calls on September 17-18, 2016 (EFTA02451909, EFTA02329688). The shift from casual direct emails ("Hey Jeff") to attorney-mediated contact ("Reaching out per Josh request") signals that the relationship had entered territory Harris considered legally sensitive enough to warrant the formality -- and the privilege protections -- of outside counsel as intermediary.

The reason for this shift became clear three months later. On December 11, 2016, Bodian organized a conference call with Alan Halperin (Paul Weiss partner) and Patrick Fenn (Akin Gump partner) with the subject line "Quick call re the Josh tax letter" (EFTA02667860). Bodian stated: "The subject of the call will be the statement that Taxpayers are not under civil or criminal investigation." Three major law firms were now coordinating on a single tax compliance matter involving Harris -- the IRS Form 8865 reasonable cause filing for the Apollo founders' BRH Holdings LP structure, a Cayman Islands partnership. The Form 8865 issue concerned the founders' failure to file information returns about their foreign partnership interests, carrying potential penalties in the hundreds of millions of dollars.

The most significant detail: Brad Karp, chairman of Paul Weiss, personally forwarded this email chain to Jeffrey Epstein with the notation "Fyi, Jeffrey." The chairman of one of America's most prestigious law firms was keeping a convicted sex offender informed of his client's sensitive IRS compliance matters. Separately, Brad Wechsler (IMAX CEO, Black Family Office) wrote to Epstein: "is PW writing for all three guys?" (EFTA02670537) -- confirming that Paul Weiss was drafting reasonable cause statements for all three Apollo co-founders, not just Black. Epstein was the central coordinator of this multi-firm tax compliance effort, with Karp, Bodian, and Fenn all reporting to or through him on matters affecting Harris's personal tax liability.

sections.title: Epstein as Intelligence and Access Broker
sections.content:
Beyond tax advisory work, Epstein's value to Harris lay in his role as a broker of introductions and intelligence. The Bill Gates dinner invitation is the clearest example: Epstein positioned himself as the connector between Harris and one of the world's wealthiest individuals, framing the introduction as an opportunity to "schmooze, get some of his ideas." A separate scheduling document (EFTA02595966) shows Epstein organizing the December 5, 2014 dinner with Gates for both Harris and Ron Baron -- functioning as a social curator for billionaire-tier networking. The deposition-style questions found in House Oversight documents (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_025876) list Harris alongside Kairat Kelimbetov (Kazakh banker), Nathan Myhrvold (former Microsoft CTO), Martin Nowak (Harvard evolutionary biologist), and Richard Axel (Columbia neuroscientist and Nobel laureate) -- the breadth of Epstein's contact network that Harris accessed.

Michael Wolff's unpublished Epstein profiles, found in four variant drafts among House Oversight documents (024239, 022905, 022753, 022850), describe the phenomenon from the inside. Wolff observed Harris attending post-conviction dinners at 9 East 71st Street, asking: "The question is why, in the face of such disgrace, with the paparazzi so near, the high and mighty still come? Perhaps simply that it's intelligence of a high order." The word "intelligence" carries a deliberate double meaning: intellectual conversation and information advantage. For someone in Harris's position -- managing one of the world's largest alternative asset portfolios -- access to Epstein's network meant access to non-public perspectives from government officials, scientists, technologists, and sovereign wealth fund managers. An Apollo analyst meeting note found in Epstein's files (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_026634) documented Harris discussing Athene, C-corp conversion, and Fund VIII performance with CFO Martin Kelly -- confirming that Epstein was simultaneously monitoring Apollo's public disclosures alongside his private advisory work, maintaining both insider access and public market intelligence on the same firm.

sections.title: The Dechert Gap and the Public Record
sections.content:
The January 2021 Dechert LLP investigation, commissioned by Apollo's Conflicts Committee, concluded that the Epstein relationship was "primarily" with Leon Black and that "neither co-founder hired Epstein." The investigation was led by Dechert, a firm with extensive private equity relationships. Its scope was defined by Apollo itself, not by an independent regulator. The documentary record assembled from DOJ Volume 11 and House Oversight Committee releases raises specific questions about the completeness of this investigation.

First, the October 22, 2013 three-founder meeting at Epstein's residence (EFTA02576529) places all three co-founders together with Epstein in a single documented event. Second, Epstein's fee proposal explicitly requiring "marc and josh" to "sign on" (EFTA02655647) names Harris as a necessary counterparty, not a passive bystander. Third, Epstein's "leon agenda" item to "sit with josh and mark re amendments" (EFTA02455405) treats the three founders as a single client unit. Fourth, Paul Weiss was "writing for all three guys" on the Form 8865 reasonable cause statements (EFTA02670537), with Epstein as the central coordinator. Fifth, Brad Karp personally forwarded Harris's sensitive tax compliance correspondence to Epstein (EFTA02667860). The narrow framing of the Dechert report -- that Epstein's relationship was primarily with Black and that "neither co-founder hired Epstein" -- is technically possible only if "hired" is defined to exclude the arrangement where Epstein proposed fees to all three founders, coordinated their tax compliance through elite law firms, and was kept informed of their IRS filings by the chairman of Paul Weiss.

Harris left Apollo in 2024 to launch 26North Partners LP, a multi-strategy investment firm. His 2024 acquisition of the Washington Commanders, approved by NFL owners in July 2023, received scrutiny over his Epstein connections during the vetting process. FEC records show Harris's political donations through 26North Partners LP, including a ,000 contribution to Gridiron-PAC (September 2024). Harris and Rowan continue to share institutional ties through the Wharton School advisory board, and the coordinated political donation patterns identified across all three Apollo founders -- 15+ shared congressional recipients including McConnell, Cotton, Graham, Barrasso, and Rubio -- suggest the co-founder partnership continues to operate as a political unit long after the formal business relationship has been restructured.

APOLLO TRIAD COMPREHENSIVE TIMELINE: All three Apollo co-founders had direct engagement with Epstein, contradicting the Dechert LLP report's framing that Epstein's relationship was primarily with Black. Evidence: (1) Oct 22 2013: Three-founder meeting (Harris+Black+Rowan) at Epstein's residence at 7:30am (EFTA02576529). (2) Oct-Nov 2013: Groff tried to organize Harris+Rowan conference call when both traveling (EFTA02576924). (3) Nov 7 2013: Harris breakfast alone with Epstein. (4) Dec 4 2013-Jan 9 2014: Harris 4 more visits. (5) Dec 2015-Aug 2016: Rowan 3+ confirmed meetings plus extensive email correspondence on TRA, inversion, Athene, Form 8865. (6) Jan 9 2016: Black directs Rowan to call Epstein re DAFs. (7) Jan 18 2016: Epstein proposes 25% Athene fee naming 'marc and josh' -- all three must sign. (8) Feb 12 2016: Epstein to Rowan: 'waiting on you to decide...what you three propose as a fee.' (9) Aug 15 2016: Leon agenda includes 'sit with josh and mark re amendments.' (10) Sept 2016: Harris routes through Bodian/Mintz Levin. (11) Apr 2018: Ruemmler asks Epstein 'Have I met Marc Rowan?' The Dechert investigation (Jan 2021) was commissioned by Apollo's own Conflicts Committee and concluded the relationship was primarily Black-Epstein. This documentary record proves otherwise.

Epstein requested 'organizational docs' from Harris in early 2014. On Feb 6 2014, Lesley Groff asked Epstein: 'Did you want me to follow up with Josh Harris and the organizational docs you requested?' (EFTA02581638). The nature of these organizational documents is not specified but given the timing (right after Apollo Global Management's Jan 2014 IPO transition) and Epstein's role as tax/structure adviser to all three Apollo founders, these likely pertained to Apollo corporate structure, partnership agreements, or tax-related organizational documents. This demonstrates Harris was providing Epstein access to Apollo internal documents at Epstein's request.

Harris and Epstein had a direct, casual email relationship. On Nov 26 2014, Harris emailed Epstein from his Apollo account: 'Hey Jeff. Sorry i missed you. Crazy week? U around any time from now to sunday? Whats this Bill Gates thing about? Tks for thinking about me.' Epstein replied: 'call me tomorw if you get a chance-I thought you might like to schmooze, get some of his ideas etc. nothing but fun friday 5th breakfast.' Harris responded: 'Cool. Will do. Thx.' This establishes Epstein was brokering introductions between Harris and Bill Gates for a Dec 5 2014 breakfast/dinner, alongside Ron Baron (EFTA02595966). The casual tone indicates established personal friendship, not formal business contact.

Epstein explicitly named Harris as a party who needed to sign off on his 25% Athene advisory fee proposal. In Jan 18 2016 email to Melanie Spinella (Leon Black assistant), Epstein wrote: 'I propose a 25% fee based on benefit to all founders...if there is a 300 overall benefit, then each founder would pay 25 m...If OK with you, marc and josh would have to sign on.' This confirms (1) Epstein expected compensation from ALL three Apollo co-founders, not just Black, (2) Harris was aware of Epstein's advisory role on the Athene restructuring, and (3) the proposed total fee was up to 75M (25% of 300M benefit). Epstein forwarded this email to himself on Mar 25 2017 (EFTA02655647), likely for record-keeping.

Epstein's 'leon agenda' memo (Aug 15 2016) includes item '14. sit with josh and mark re amendments' alongside '10 apollo insurance AThene.' This confirms Epstein was simultaneously managing all three Apollo co-founders' business. The 'amendments' likely refer to Apollo partnership agreement modifications needed for the Athene merger/restructuring. Harris and Rowan were not passive bystanders to the Black-Epstein relationship -- they were active participants in Epstein's advisory work on Apollo corporate matters, including the B Athene tax optimization, TRA modifications, and corporate inversion planning.

Harris delegated Bob Bodian (Partner at Mintz Levin law firm, RIBodian@mintz.com) as his intermediary with Epstein in Sept 2016. On Sept 15, Bodian emailed Epstein: 'Reaching out per Josh request. Reachable tomorrow on cell after 1:30.' Epstein replied Sept 17: 'does now work?' Multiple scheduling documents show Bodian-Epstein calls on Sept 17-18 2016 (EFTA02451909, EFTA02329688). This is significant because it shows Harris maintaining the Epstein relationship through a legal intermediary at a prominent law firm 8 years after Epstein's 2008 conviction, and that the relationship required enough legal sophistication to route through outside counsel rather than direct communication.

EFTA02667860 reveals a conference call on Dec 11, 2016 between Bob Bodian (Mintz Levin, Harris intermediary), Alan Halperin (Paul Weiss partner), and Patrick Fenn (Akin Gump partner) with subject line 'Quick call re the Josh tax letter.' Bodian stated: 'The subject of the call will be the statement that Taxpayers are not under civil or criminal investigation.' This establishes that Harris's tax matter (the Form 8865 reasonable cause filing) was serious enough to require coordination between three major law firms (Mintz Levin, Paul Weiss, Akin Gump) and involved representations to the IRS about the investigation status of the 'Taxpayers' (i.e., the Apollo founders). Brad Karp personally forwarded this email chain to Jeffrey Epstein with 'Fyi, Jeffrey.' This means Epstein was being kept informed of Harris's sensitive IRS tax compliance matter by Paul Weiss's chairman himself.

An Apollo analyst meeting note (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_026634) was found in Epstein's files, documenting a meeting with 'Apollo Co-Founder Josh Harris and CFO Martin Kelly' discussing Apollo's growth outlook, Athene, tax reform implications (carried interest rates, C-corp conversion, interest deductibility), and Fund VIII performance (B+ projected cash carry). The analyst note (by Michael Carrier, CFA) maintained a Neutral rating with  price target. The presence of this document in Epstein's files is consistent with Epstein monitoring Apollo's public disclosures and business strategy alongside his private advisory role. The document discusses the exact topics Epstein was advising on privately (Athene, tax structure, C-corp conversion) -- confirming Epstein had both insider access AND public market intelligence on Apollo simultaneously.

EFTA02670537/EFTA02670773: Brad Wechsler (IMAX CEO, Leon Black Family Office) wrote to Jeffrey Epstein: 'I got a download from jc and rj on the 8865 call earlier today and there is an issue I would like to discuss with you. Also, are you interacting with brad karp on the reasonable cause cover note or do you want me to? Finally, is PW writing for all three guys?'
